main_text.p: re: cujus equidem judicii rationes manifestae (sunt ex omnibus iis quae hactenus differuimus, quaeque evidentia reddidimus. Sed unicum adhuc Experimentum restat, quod patriae suae quàm maximè familiare profitetur D. Comes, id quoque videndum. Laetissimis pascuis, quibus gaudent, boves interdum adeò pinguefieri, ait, ut pingue-do diftensa mole depressa in crura, imò pedes usque, propendeat: id quod in causa dicit esse, ut apostemata in plantis pedum ipsis oriantur, ex quibus multum pu-ris & vitiosi humoris profluat, quæ grefsum animalis manifeste impediunt, proprietarios hoc valdè ægrè ferre, inquit, licet enim propterea boves non minus valeant, qui ad cultrum emantur; nihilominus tamen lucrum ipsorum calculo male respondere, quòd eos Londinum (ubi boves opimi pro tota Anglia venduntur,) ducere nequeant, adeòque in ipso loco, ubi caro illa dimidio minus constat quàm Londini, eos

page.notes: Page is badly damaged and the text is partly illegible; the transcription of the heavily blurred lines near the foot (the lines beginning "adeòque", "dimidio") and of the catchword-like marks ("ɔx", "b 1") is uncertain. Italic and roman distinctions were approximated; the first lines "re: cujus equidem judicii rationes" are partly obscured.
